method: Manual source review, saved-trajectory diagnostics and rented-host regression tests

findings.finding: Auxiliary carry-stage credit can be granted when departure preceded the ten-control grasp
findings.fix: Separately versioned ordered_progress_v3 requires a later support-departure transition

findings.finding: Initial candidates apply nearly continuous arm residuals and frequently lose engagement; observed joint RMS was about 0.011 to 0.025 radians.
findings.improvement: Conservative per-parameter initial arm/hidden exploration, retaining larger gripper exploration
findings.interpretation: Consistent with overly disruptive exploration, but matched seeds do not isolate causal harm in this simulator.

findings.finding: Safe inactivity ties with safe target contact without closure, and the native point is not retained in the original candidate population
findings.improvement: Native-anchor injection for both CMA-ES and random search, plus a safe-target-contact tie-break below strict completion
